title: Mills forest: Lean 4 formalization and ECPP primality certificates
description: Supplementary material for the paper "Mills-type prime-representing constants for exponents below two: a compactness argument" by L. F. Marcelino: a Lean 4/Mathlib formalization of the compactness deduction and ECPP primality certificates for the explicit chain for the golden ratio. The Lean code is released under the Apache License 2.0; the certificates under CC BY 4.0.
